text: move 216 (merging), D4a-02: branch F15 named at the fourth order, key add-step:P04:T4-008, 42 members (read from the level matrix by d4_cut.py). Name: the plan kept current: correcting, updating and re-circulating the template. What it changes: P04 says members circulate a template or coordinates and ask strays to keep to them. In these rooms the template needs upkeep of its own: members correct the reference against the canvas, replace stale plans, make updates noticeable, route helpers to the current version and message friendly placers who still follow a superseded one. Ground: keys.

move 217 (merging), D4a-02: branch F16 named at the third order, key add-step:P23:T3-014, 35 members (read from the level matrix by d4_cut.py). Name: the chat kept open: invitations renewed, entrants screened, outcomes relayed to the thread. What it changes: P23 (a candidate) says members move planning into a chat and invite helpers. In these rooms the chat's access is upkeep: members replace expired invitations and broken links, screen who comes in, and relay decisions back to the thread for those outside. Ground: keys.

move 218 (merging), D4a-02: branch F17 named at the fourth order, key add-step:P11:T4-026, 36 members (read from the level matrix by d4_cut.py). Name: the marking provisional and contested: success judged and credit disputed while the work goes on. What it changes: P11 says that when a work is up the room marks it: announces, celebrates and credits. In these rooms marking comes while the work is still live and is open to dispute: success is judged by what survives, completion is provisional, upkeep goes on, and credit is challenged and corrected. Ground: keys.

move 219 (splitting), D4a-02: subform F18 of F17 at the third order, key add-step:P11:T3-009, 15 members (read from the level matrix by d4_cut.py). Name: success judged while upkeep continues. What it changes: Within F17, the room judges success by recognizable survival rather than a perfect mark, treats completion as a milestone, and keeps the obligation to maintain. Ground: keys.

move 220 (splitting), D4a-02: subform F19 of F17 at the third order, key add-step:P11:T3-043, 14 members (read from the level matrix by d4_cut.py). Name: credit contested during the work. What it changes: Within F17, members dispute and correct who made the work while it is still being placed: accusations, denials, competing labour claims and corrected omissions. Ground: keys.

move 221 (merging), D4a-02: branch F20 named at the third order, key add-step:P12:T3-117, 10 members (read from the level matrix by d4_cut.py). Name: the close as news: late arrivals told that placement has ended. What it changes: P12 says the room records what happened and marks the end. In these rooms the end itself must travel: members who did not know offer to rebuild or ask for help, and others tell them that placement has ended and correct the stale call. Ground: keys.

move 222 (merging), D4a-02: branch F21 named at the fourth order, key restrict:K01:T4-001, 32 members (read from the level matrix by d4_cut.py). Name: the canvas call not a joke: the April Fools frame kept apart from the canvas work. What it changes: K01 says that a claim in the host sub, a call to the canvas included, may be a joke. In these rooms the play stays with the sub's own business: its fakes and takeovers do not make the canvas calls jokes, and the frame does not decide what the canvas work was. Ground: keys.

move 223 (merging), D4a-02: branch F22 named at the fourth order, key add-condition:P16:T4-017, 30 members (read from the level matrix by d4_cut.py). Name: help conditional on the helper's own work and spare hands. What it changes: P16 says rooms help one another, trade help and turn requests away. In these rooms help waits on conditions the statement does not hold: the helper's own work must be safe or finished, the helper must have pixels and time to spare, and the terms (space, non-interference, recognizable help) must hold. Ground: keys.

move 224 (merging), D4a-02: branch F23 named at the fourth order, key add-condition:P13:T4-028, 30 members (read from the level matrix by d4_cut.py). Name: the close scoped to the original canvas: continuation renewed, uncertain and contested. What it changes: P13 places the decision near the close and after it. In these rooms the stop at hour 73 binds only the original canvas: on successor canvases placement goes on, and continuation is often one member's attempt, contested or unfinished, and conditioned on tolerable upkeep and access. Ground: keys.

move 225 (merging), D4a-02: branch F24 named at the fourth order, key restrict:P14:T4-009, 27 members (read from the level matrix by d4_cut.py). Name: machine hands debated, not shown placing. What it changes: P14 says members add placements with scripts, bots and spare accounts, and argue over them. In these rooms only the arguing part shows: scripts are offered, debated, refused or attributed to outsiders, and the room's own machine placement is not shown. Ground: keys.

move 226 (merging), D4a-02: branch F25 named at the fourth order, key restrict:P13:T4-028, 27 members (read from the level matrix by d4_cut.py). Name: carrying on in talk: proposals and single attempts, not shown taken up. What it changes: P13 says the room decides what to keep. In these rooms carrying on shows as invitations, proposals and one member's attempt; collective uptake and durability are not shown, and some reuse begins during live placement. Ground: keys.

move 227 (merging), D4a-02: branch F26 named at the third order, key restrict:P05:T3-010, 23 members (read from the level matrix by d4_cut.py). Name: the telling clause not shown at the border: informed members contest the terms. What it changes: As in F07, P05's added clause holds only in part, here where the planned change is a border or compromise agreed with a neighbour: members who know the terms contest them or refuse the concession, or the record does not show untold keepers or the loss. Ground: keys.

move 228 (merging), D4a-02: branch F27 named at the fourth order, key restrict:P05:T4-013, 27 members (read from the level matrix by d4_cut.py). Name: the telling clause not shown in keeping: interference seen, its cause and loss not. What it changes: As in F07, P05's added clause holds only in part, here in watching, repairing and defending: interference with a planned change is seen, but who was told, whether keepers knew, and whether the change was lost for want of telling are not, and informed disagreement also occurs. Ground: keys.

move 229 (merging), D4a-02: branch F28 named at the third order, key add-condition:P16:T3-010, 22 members (read from the level matrix by d4_cut.py). Name: help at the border conditional: on the home work, the terms and harm to a third room. What it changes: As in F22, help waits on conditions the statement does not hold, here where neighbours settle borders: the helper's home work comes first, help depends on stopping attacks or on sparing a work, it can entail destroying a third room's mark, and offers often stay offers. Ground: keys.

move 230 (merging), D4a-02: branch F29 named at the third order, key add-condition:P23:T3-014, 25 members (read from the level matrix by d4_cut.py). Name: the chat's reach conditional: access, and the return of decisions to the thread. What it changes: P23 (a candidate) says members move planning into a chat and bring its decisions back. In these rooms the chat's reach depends on working access, and those outside it learn only what returns to the thread; its decisions do not bind those who cannot see them. Ground: keys.

move 231 (merging), D4a-02: branch F30 named at the third order, key restrict:P23:T3-014, 24 members (read from the level matrix by d4_cut.py). Name: the chat seen only through its invitations and returned reports, not its choices. What it changes: P23 (a candidate) says the room's design, borders and diplomacy can be settled in the chat. In these rooms the record shows only the outside of the chat: invitations, venue proposals and reports that come back. Its deliberation, membership and authority are not shown. Ground: keys.

move 232 (merging), D4a-02: branch F31 named at the third order, key restrict:P19:T3-010, 22 members (read from the level matrix by d4_cut.py). Name: hosting as one-off permission: requests and leave, no standing host rule. What it changes: P19 says one room's work lives on another's mark under the host's rule, with hosts ruling on requests. In these rooms hosting shows only as a guest's request and a one-off permission, often provisional or contested; a standing host rule, an approval procedure or durable guest status is not shown. Ground: keys.

move 233 (merging), D4a-02: branch F32 named at the third order, key link:P05:T3-009, 21 members (read from the level matrix by d4_cut.py). Name: the marking returns to keeping: celebration followed by renewed defence. What it changes: The model runs from building to marking (A07) and from building to keeping (A03), but not from marking back to keeping. In these rooms it does: a celebration or completion post draws renewed defence calls, repair and night cover in its own thread. Ground: keys.

move 234 (merging), D4a-02: branch F33 named at the fourth order, key add-step:P04:T4-006, 23 members (read from the level matrix by d4_cut.py). Name: the plan kept current while the design settles. What it changes: As in F15, the template needs upkeep of its own, here while the design is still being settled: members check details against one another's instructions, correct and replace the reference, retire outdated posts and message overwriters, so that one updated plan replaces competing ones. Ground: keys.
